title: Are you sure? Measuring models bias in content moderation through uncertainty

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring model uncertainty using conformal prediction techniques (Brier Score and Conformity Delta) and comparing the alignment of model predictions with hate speech annotations provided by male versus female annotators.

Assessing model fairness by computing uncertainty metrics and Demographic Divergence on text classifications, specifically comparing predictions against ground-truth labels provided by white versus non-white annotators.
